recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to white (#FFFFFF).
2. Place the slide-number badge: a yellow (#FFD700) circle in the top-right corner with black text '36'.
3. Create the left grid container: 4 rows x 2 columns, approx 0-66% slide width and 5-85% slide height; it will hold 7 confusion-matrix panels and 1 caption box.
4. Place confusion-matrix panel 1 in the top-left grid cell: red-bordered panel with a red (#C00000) header bar containing white bold text 'Threshold=0.0'; inside, a 2x2 table with top header 'Predicted as' over columns 'P' and 'N', left header 'Actual' beside rows 'P' and 'N', and cell values row P: 5, 0; row N: 6, 0; to the right of the table, a text box with 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=6/(6+0)=1'.
5. Place confusion-matrix panel 2 in the top-right grid cell: red-bordered panel with red (#C00000) header bar and white bold text 'Threshold=0.6'; 2x2 table with 'Predicted as' (P, N) and 'Actual' (P, N); cell values row P: 3, 1; row N: 1, 5; side text box with 'TPR=3/(3+1)=0.6' and 'FPR=1/(1+5)=0.16'.
6. Place confusion-matrix panel 3 in the second-row left grid cell: red-bordered panel with red (#C00000) header bar and white bold text 'Threshold=0.1'; 2x2 table with 'Predicted as' (P, N) and 'Actual' (P, N); cell values row P: 5, 0; row N: 4, 2; side text box with 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=4/(4+2)=0.66'.
7. Place confusion-matrix panel 4 in the second-row right grid cell: red-bordered panel with red (#C00000) header bar and white bold text 'Threshold=0.7'; 2x2 table with 'Predicted as' (P, N) and 'Actual' (P, N); cell values row P: 3, 2; row N: 0, 6; side text box with 'TPR=3/(3+2)=0.6' and 'FPR=0/(0+6)=0'.
8. Place confusion-matrix panel 5 in the third-row left grid cell: red-bordered panel with red (#C00000) header bar and white bold text 'Threshold=0.3'; 2x2 table with 'Predicted as' (P, N) and 'Actual' (P, N); cell values row P: 5, 0; row N: 2, 4; side text box with 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=2/(2+4)=0.33'.
9. Place confusion-matrix panel 6 in the third-row right grid cell: red-bordered panel with red (#C00000) header bar and white bold text 'Threshold=1'; 2x2 table with 'Predicted as' (P, N) and 'Actual' (P, N); cell values row P: 0, 5; row N: 0, 6; side text box with 'TPR=0/(0+5)=0' and 'FPR=0/(0+6)=0'.
10. Place confusion-matrix panel 7 in the bottom-row left grid cell: red-bordered panel with red (#C00000) header bar and white bold text 'Threshold=0.4'; 2x2 table with 'Predicted as' (P, N) and 'Actual' (P, N); cell values row P: 4, 1; row N: 1, 5; side text box with 'TPR=4/(4+1)=4/5' and 'FPR=1/(1+5)=0.16'.
11. Place the caption box in the bottom-row right grid cell: light blue/gray (#D9E1F2) fill, dark blue (#1F4E79) border, and black text 'ROC Curve for Same Model -different thresholds'; this is also the reconstructed slide title text.
12. Place the ROC chart on the right side, approx 66-95% slide width and 10-75% slide height: line chart with light blue (#D9E1F2) grid background, X-axis label 'FPR', Y-axis label 'TPR', purple (#800080) curve, green (#00AA00) circular start point at top-left, white (#FFFFFF) circular nodes labeled '0.7' near bottom-left, '0.6', '0.4', '0.3', '0.1', '0.0' near top-right, and '1.0' at bottom-right axis, red (#FF0000) annotation arrows labeled 'Best (TPR)' and 'Best (FPR)', and a green (#00AA00) arrow labeled 'The Best (If Any)' pointing to the top-left corner.
13. Place the first formula text box in the bottom-right area, approx 66-95% slide width and 75-95% slide height, above the legend matrix: black text on white reading 'TPR = TP / (TP + FN)'.
14. Place the second formula text box below the first formula text box: black text on white reading 'FPR = FP / (FP + TN)'.
15. Place the legend confusion matrix below the two formula text boxes: 2x2 table with top header 'Predicted as' over columns 'P' and 'N', left header 'Actual' beside rows 'P' and 'N'; cell values row P: 'TP' on green (#00AA00), 'FN' on red (#FF0000); row N: 'FP' on red (#FF0000), 'TN' on green (#00AA00); black text.
16. Apply typography: black sans-serif for all body text and matrix numbers; white bold sans-serif on #C00000 for the 7 threshold panel headers; no italics; no bullet glyphs.
